Jordyn Tyson's NFL debut: 15 routes, 4 targets, 0.27 TPRR

Devaughn Vele: 42 routes, 4 targets, 0.13 TPRR

His time is coming.
items.why: Vele leads in routes but lags in target rate; Tyson efficient on limited snaps in debut.
items.implication: Vele holds high route share but target competition rising with Tyson.
items.opportunity: Watch Tyson for expanded role; Vele remains a volume play.

items.implication: Daniels and other healthy Rams WRs (Mumpfield, Atwell, Whittington) see expanded roles.
